senses.zh_definition: 泰山：埃德加·赖斯·巴勒斯创作的虚构人物，自幼在非洲丛林中由类人猿抚养长大。
senses.en_definition: A fictional jungle hero created by Edgar Rice Burroughs, raised by apes in Africa.
senses.ms_definition: Watak fiksyen ciptaan Edgar Rice Burroughs yang dibesarkan oleh beruk besar di hutan Afrika.
senses.nuances: 属于角色专名，正文写作 Tarzan。根据语境也可指以该角色为主角的作品；不可直接当作马来语普通名词，释为所有丛林居民或强壮男子。角色背景见 [Tarzan 官方作品介绍](https://tarzan.com/book-tarzan-of-the-apes/)。

dual_scenarios.en: This exhibition traces the development of Tarzan as a character in novels and films.

etymology.historical_story: Tarzan entered popular culture through Edgar Rice Burroughs's story published in 1912, followed by a book edition in 1914. Films and other adaptations carried the character far beyond his original readership. Malay references retain the character's name as a complete proper noun, so its letters should not be interpreted as Malay roots or affixes. [Author estate biography](https://www.edgarriceburroughs.com/erb-biography/erb-biography-page-2/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 Tarzan，就想起抓着藤蔓穿越丛林的“泰山”；把名字和角色画面一起记住。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论文学或电影角色时语气中性；把真人叫作 Tarzan 可能带有取笑其外貌、衣着或举止的意味。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合影视、阅读和角色讨论。除非对方接受这个昵称，否则避免用来称呼他人，尤其不要借此贬低族群或生活方式。
